802.headline: A close look at the prizes

803.body:
The key fact about "Triple Red 777s" is how its thirteen prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

The numbers for "Triple Red 777s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.

819.body:
The prize money on "30X Cash" leans toward the smaller prizes. It is spread over eight prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $30,000. Games built like this pay small prizes often and large prizes rarely. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

How far "30X Cash" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.
